messages:
Priya: Quick recap from today's multi-region failover game-day. Overall success but found three recurring gaps that could bite us in a real outage: route convergence visibility, test-restore isolation, and runbook version drift. Putting proposed remediation items below. Please ack and adjust owners/dates.

Raj: Noted. The routing side-effect was the weird 20s of microloops when the BGP sessions flapped. We need a visibility metric (p95/p99 convergence) and an automated stop-gap that delays traffic-swap until convergence metric passes for X seconds.

Marco: Envoy pools behaved fine except one regional pool had stale weight labels after a canary deploy earlier this week. CI didn't catch it because the label is optional in schema. I'll make it required and add a rollback hook to the deployment job.

Taylor: Backup integrity checks all OK, but our restore steps were manual and used shared credentials. We should add a canned isolated restore job that runs in a sandbox project with ephemeral creds and verifies data + app-level sanity checks.

Sam: Ops automation ran the failover but didn't verify downstream dependencies (billing, auth) in the second region. We'll add dependency smoke tests and a checklist to gate cutover.

dr-bot: game-day-2026-04-15: summary posted, auto-created tickets: INF-510, INF-511, INF-512.

Priya: Action list (pls confirm):

A) Routing convergence monitoring + gating
- What: expose route-converge histogram (per-prefix) and a gating rule that prevents traffic-shift if p95 > 5s.
- Owner: Raj
- Due: 2026-04-08
- Ticket: INF-510

B) Deploy job sanity & Envoy label enforcement
- What: make healthcheck label mandatory in envoy config schema; add deploy-step sanity to fail on missing labels; add small e2e test that simulates weight rebind.
- Owner: Marco
- Due: 2026-04-01
- PR: draft #782

C) Sandboxed restore pipeline + ephemeral creds
- What: create a one-click "test restore" Jenkins job that uses ephemeral GCP service account and isolated namespace, runs schema checks + app smoke tests. Output a signed artefact with restore-id and verification checklist.
- Owner: Taylor
- Due: 2026-03-30
- Ticket: INF-511

D) Dependency smoke tests for regional cutover
- What: small test suite (auth, billing, telemetry ingestion) that runs post-cutover and must pass before we mark failover complete. Integrate into the runbook as a gating step.
- Owner: Sam
- Due: 2026-04-05
- Ticket: INF-512

E) Runbook versioning + authoritative source
- What: pin the DR runbook to a README in infra/playbooks repo and require PR approval from two oncall engineers for any change. Add a changelog entry on every edit.
- Owner: Priya
- Due: 2026-03-28
- Repo: infra/playbooks (branch: dr-runbook)

Sample "sandbox restore" commands to include in the runbook preflight (place under "sandboxed-verify"):

```
# create ephemeral creds (example)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/key.json --iam-account=dr-sandbox@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/key.json
# restore into sandbox clusterrdb restore --from s3://redwood-backups/prod/2026-04-15 --to cluster=dr-sandbox --verify --namespace=dr-test-$(date +%s)
# run app-level smoke testskubectl --context dr-sandbox -n dr-test-$(date +%s) run smoke-test --image=redwood/smoke:latest --command -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sSf http://app/health || exit 1"
```

Priya: Also notes on recurring patterns: we've seen label/config drift twice in last 3 months after fast canaries, and two game-days in a row had restore steps that relied on shared creds. These are systemic and need the pipeline fixes above.

Raj: ack. I'll add Grafana panels + alert rule proto. Proposal: alert if new route convergence p95 > 10s for 5m. Will post dashboard JSON in INF-510.

Marco: ack. I'll make the label mandatory and add the deploy fail-fast hook. Will open PR and link in INF-512.

Taylor: ack. I'll prototype the sandboxed-restore job today and add a verification step that posts a signed logfile to S3. Will link INF-511.

Sam: ack. I'll draft the dependency test suite and start by adding auth + billing checks. Will coordinate with platform-team for test credentials.

Priya: Good. Let's also lock a recurring quarterly game-day into calendars and include an external-customer observer slot. Proposed date: 2026-07-15. Owner: Priya to calendar invite by 2026-03-26.

Priya: I'll update the generated tickets INF-510..INF-512 with owners/dates and close this thread. If anyone thinks of more follow-ups, drop them here and dr-bot will append to the ticket. Thanks! :rocket:
